[ce] CalcExpress - Diagnose Script.vi

Owning Palette: CalcExpress

The VI returns names of variables and functions referenced in a CalcExpress expression or sequential script. To analyze a parsed script, pass reference to its instance context to CE InstanceRef control; otherwise, pass a script source to expression control.

Click the parameters for more information

 

CE InstanceRef is a reference number for a CalcExpress instance that contains a parsed CalcExpress expression/script. CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi returns a value that can be wired directly to this terminal.
expression should contain an expression/script is to be parsed. See CalcExpress Script Syntax for more information.
Items specifies what names the VI is to return:

0VariablesThe VI returns variable names. It's default value.
1FunctionsThe VI returns function names (both FuncVI and FastFunc functions).
2FuncVI functionsThe VI returns names of FuncVI functions only.
3FastFunc functionsThe VI returns names of FastFunc functions only.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
sort (F) specifies whether an output array of names need be sorted. If it is TRUE, elements in Array of Items are sorted in alphabetical case-insensitive order. Default value is FALSE.
dup CE InstanceRef is a flow-through parameter with the same value as CE InstanceRef.
Array of Items returns names of requested items found in the script. The array doesn't contain duplicate elements.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
Original List of Items returns a spread-sheet string with item names in order they are met in the script. For function, a function name is folowed by number of arguments in the function call.
